description:
We are a team of enthusiastic and creative students passionate about technology, innovation, space exploration, and solving real-world problems. We are excited to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, where we aim to develop innovative solutions using data, coding, and teamwork.

We welcome motivated team members who are interested in programming, AI/ML, web development, data analysis, research, design, and presentation.
summary:
ASTROGUARD AI is an intelligent astronaut health monitoring system designed to support astronauts’ physical well-being during space missions. Space conditions such as microgravity, radiation exposure, isolation and disrupted biological rhythms can create health risks.

The system monitors health parameters, including heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate and sleep patterns. Using Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and real-time data analysis, it examines health information, identifies unusual patterns and generates early warnings about possible health abnormalities.

An interactive dashboard displays astronauts’ current health status, historical records, monitoring graphs and emergency alerts. It also helps mission control teams remotely review health information and make informed decisions.

The main goal of ASTROGUARD AI is to support continuous health monitoring, enable earlier identification of potential problems, reduce medical response delays and improve astronaut safety. By providing health insights, the system aims to contribute to safer and more sustainable human space exploration.
details: ASTROHEALTH AI is an intelligent astronaut health monitoring system designed to improve astronaut safety during space missions. It monitors vital health parameters such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature and oxygen levels. Using Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and real-time data analysis, it identifies unusual health patterns and generates early warning alerts. The system provides an interactive dashboard displaying health status, monitoring graphs and emergency notifications for mission control teams. Developed using Python, Flask, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Scikit-learn, the project aims to support early health risk detection, faster medical responses and safer, more sustainable space exploration.
